# Writable seed reference

A seed supplies the initial file only when its target is absent. Existing targets stay writable and are preserved during activation. A changed baseline therefore does not update an existing target automatically.

## History

- 2026-10-19: an isolated preservation check passed; rerunning the helper retained an edited target. This result does not establish current GUI behavior.

# Binding migration

Use this procedure when an existing writable Mod+T binding needs the new repository default. Rebuilding preserves existing files. The 2026-10-20 check passed on synthetic files; a real session was not tested.

## Procedure

Stop DMS before editing its fragment so it cannot overwrite the change. Back up only the affected binds.kdl file to a unique name. Merge Mod+T from the baseline while preserving other bindings. Validate the merged KDL before restarting DMS. Then test Mod+T in the session; restore the backup if the change fails. Restarting DMS and changing the live file are user-run migration steps, not performed by this document.

## History

- 2026-10-20: synthetic-file merge and KDL validation PASS. No activation or real-session shortcut test was performed; the active binding remains unverified.

The synthetic-file check on 2026-10-20 passed, but a real session was not tested. Rebuilding does not overwrite existing writable files.
